## Checklist

- [ ] One task, atomic commits, Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:cov` (100%) and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] Every new component has stories (default, loading, empty, error, dark) passing the a11y checks
- [ ] Checked in a real browser, against the Mock services and, when relevant, a local pyxis-api
- [ ] README and ADRs updated when touched
- [ ] No secret in the browser bundle; demo and test data are invented
